roleLabel: Short-range Frost Mage — cleaves the nearest secondary target and buffs Mage/Duelist debuff loops
bestFor: Formation boards with Pimenta (Lover pair) or Mage/Duelist Debuff tribal
strength: Permafrost stacks and splash-Frost the nearest enemy to her target; Breezy turns every Debuff into AS/Magic for Mage/Duelist
weakness: Short effective range — if she cannot stick near the fight, Permafrost does little

howToPlay.early: Draft with a plan for who stands in front of her. With Pimenta, Lover on either side is a real archetype. Alone, she needs a tank she can stand behind.
howToPlay.mid: Breezy = Backup Mage/Duelist Debuff engine. Lover = permanent Defense for the hero directly in front (Pimenta bonus). Brisk = Permafrost bonus damage can Crit and she gains Crit on cast. Pick tribal, formation pair, or Crit Frost carry.
howToPlay.late: Keep Debuffs flowing so Breezy pays. Stack Magic/Crit for Brisk. Do not relocate her away from the frontline pair mid-run without rewriting the plan.
howToPlay.positioning: Just behind the tank (ideally Pimenta). Lover only works if someone occupies the tile directly in front every combat.

abilityNotes.Permafrost: Empowered autos cleave Frost onto the nearest enemy to the target. Stand her where two bodies are always close — empty side lanes waste the cleave.

specNotes.The Breezy: Take on Mage/Duelist Debuff boards — every Debuff proc speeds and Magics the tribe.
specNotes.The Lover: Hard-commit formation with Pimenta (or another frontliner). Skip if you will not keep someone in the front tile.
specNotes.The Brisk: Crit Frost path for Sal as personal carry. Take when you can stack Crit and keep her attacking.

relicReasons.mages-elemental-banner-595: Elemental Mage banner for Frost identity.
relicReasons.arcane-amplifier-2014: Magic amp glue when specialty relics miss.

faq.question: Is Sal good in Guildrun?
faq.answer: Excellent with Pimenta/Lover or Debuff tribal. Awkward as a lonely long-range Mage — she wants to stand on the fight.

faq.question: What class is Sal?
faq.answer: Mage. Role focus: short-range Frost applicator and formation support (especially with Pimenta).

faq.question: What relics work with Sal?
faq.answer: Mage Precise/Elemental pieces, Arcane amplifiers, and Crit tools for Brisk.

faq.question: How do you play Sal?
faq.answer: Park her behind a tank, stack Permafrost, and either run Lover+Pimenta, Breezy tribal, or Brisk Crit carry.

tips: Check the front tile every fight if you took Lover — empty means zero permanent Defense.
Pimenta + Sal Lover is a package; drafting only one without the formation plan is half a build.
